summary: Fence terminal agent retirement against an inspected declaration and runtime

schema.detail: Adds optional desired_revision and runtime_incarnation fields to agent.retired claims. Both supplied fences participate in durable idempotency matching.

rules.detail: agents retire accepts --expect-revision (the desired content revision in agents show value.revision) and --expect-incarnation (value.incarnation_id). The retirement append transaction refuses mismatches with distinct typed errors and expected/current details. Identical keyed retries replay; changed fences conflict.

compatibility.detail: The optional client action parameter expect_revision adds a content revision fence without changing fence.runtime_desired_revision, which remains the selected declaration claim ID. The existing runtime_incarnation fence is now recorded in the retirement claim. Omitting flags preserves existing CLI behavior. Retirement requires all configured members to advertise the current registry.

manual.detail: No configuration changes. Pass the observed revision and incarnation when conditional retirement is required.

recovery.detail: A refused fence applies no retirement. Inspect current state before submitting a new retirement with a new idempotency key.
